title: c-MYC can Form Phase Condensates via its DNA Binding Domain
authors: Udhaya Vijayakumar; Ruchi Choudhary; Wee-Joo Chng; Melissa Fullwood
one_liner_zh: 该文研究c-MYC通过DNA结合域形成相分离凝聚体，虽涉及DNA结合域但未聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅与课题弱相关。
abstract: The c-MYC oncogene is overexpressed in cancers. Phase condensates are membrane-less cellular compartments in cells. Using the optoDroplet system, which leverages optogenetics for condensate dynamics studies, here we showed c-MYC has the capability to form phase condensates. Moreover, the 3’ terminus of c-MYC, which contains a DNA binding domain but no intrinsic disordered regions, is sufficient to form phase condensates. Our research contributes to a better understanding of c-MYC biology.
abstract_zh: c-MYC癌基因在癌症中过表达。相凝聚体（phase condensates）是细胞中无膜细胞区室。利用光遗传学系统optoDroplet（用于凝聚体动力学研究），我们在此展示了c-MYC具有形成相凝聚体的能力。此外，c-MYC的3'末端（包含DNA结合域但无内在无序区域）足以形成相凝聚体。我们的研究有助于更深入地理解c-MYC的生物学功能。
